title: Every bus and train in Mississauga in 24 hours
description:
Every bus and train running in Mississauga on an average October weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds.

I took the October 2026 timetables, kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays, and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside the Mississauga city limits. The faded ones are just outside.

Busiest moment: 344 vehicles at 5:26 pm.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Thanksgiving (October 12).
